## Overview

## Green anoles retreat to the leaf litter

```{r plot-survey-data}
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5
#| out.width: 66%

otms_data <- readRDS("data/otms-data.rds")

# latitudes of locations
otms_data <- otms_data |>
  mutate(
    lat = case_when(
      location == "MIA" ~ 25.7617,
      location == "PSL" ~ 27.305,
      location == "ORL" ~ 28.5383,
      location == "GNV" ~ 29.6516,
      location == "ATL" ~ 33.7490
    )
  )

# predict CTmin by latitude
pred_ctmin <- tibble(
  lat = seq(25, 35, by = 0.1),
  ctmin = 57 - 1.68 * lat - 41.67 + 1.48 * lat
)

# read and summarize survey data
survey <- readRDS("data/sleepy-lizard-survey-data.rds")
survey_sum <- survey |>
  group_by(year, doy) |>
  summarise(
    count = n() - 1,
    presence = ifelse(count > 0, 1, 0)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    continuous_doy = ifelse(year == 2026, doy + 365, doy)
  ) |>
  filter(continuous_doy < (365 + 30)) |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(paste(year, doy), format = "%Y %j")
  ) |>
  ungroup()

# estimate sunset times for Atlanta, GA
my_year <- 2026
my_dates <- seq(
  as.Date(sprintf("%d-01-01", my_year)),
  as.Date(sprintf("%d-12-31", my_year)),
  by = "day"
)
my_lat <- 33.7490
my_lon <- -84.3880
sunset_times <- getSunlightTimes(
  date = my_dates,
  lat = my_lat,
  lon = my_lon,
  keep = "sunset",
  tz = "America/New_York"
)
sunset_times$doy <- yday(sunset_times$date)
sunset_times$mod_sunset <- hour(sunset_times$sunset) * 60 + minute(sunset_times$sunset) # nolint
sunset_times <- sunset_times |> select(doy, mod_sunset)

# filter otm data
otm_data_ATL <- otms_data |>
  filter(location == "ATL") |>
  filter(year > 24) |>
  arrange(id, year, doy, mod) |>
  filter(microhabitat == "branch") |>
  left_join(sunset_times, by = "doy") |>
  filter(mod > mod_sunset & mod < mod_sunset + 60) |>
  mutate(
    year = year + 2000
  ) |>
  mutate(
    temp = ifelse(year == 2025 & doy < 200, NA, temp),
    temp = ifelse(year == 2026 & doy > 30, NA, temp),
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(temp)) |>
  group_by(year, doy) |>
  summarise(
    mean_temp = mean(temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_temp = max(temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_temp = min(temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(paste(year, doy), format = "%Y %j")
  )

# predict CTmin at ATL latitude
ctmin_atl <- 57 - 1.68 * my_lat - 41.67 + 1.48 * my_lat

# plot survey data and OTM data
ggplot() +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = c(1, 0, ctmin_atl / max(otm_data_ATL$mean_temp, na.rm = TRUE)),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = c("gray80", "darkblue", "steelblue"),
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  annotate(
    "label",
    x = as.Date("2025-10-01"),
    y = ctmin_atl / max(otm_data_ATL$mean_temp, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.05,
    label = expression(CT[min]),
    color = "steelblue",
    size = 5,
    fill = "white",
    vjust = 1
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = otm_data_ATL,
    aes(x = date, y = mean_temp / max(otm_data_ATL$mean_temp, na.rm = TRUE)),
    color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = otm_data_ATL,
    aes(
      x = date,
      ymin = min_temp / max(otm_data_ATL$mean_temp, na.rm = TRUE),
      ymax = max_temp / max(otm_data_ATL$mean_temp, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = survey_sum,
    aes(x = date, y = presence),
    color = "darkgreen", size = 3, alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    data = survey_sum,
    aes(x = date, y = presence),
    method = "glm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    method.args = list(family = binomial(link = "logit")),
    color = "darkgreen", se = FALSE, linewidth = 2
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Observation Probability",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      ~ . * max(otm_data_ATL$mean_temp, na.rm = TRUE),
      name = "Predicted Lizard Body Temperature (°C)"
    ),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2)
  ) +
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "1 month",
    date_labels = "%b-%Y"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(
      color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5
    ),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.25),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11)
  ) +
  labs(color = NULL)

```

```{r model-retreating-temp}
survey_sum_model <- survey_sum |>
  left_join(otm_data_ATL, by = c("year", "doy", "date"))

# model
mod <- glm(
  presence ~ mean_temp,
  data = survey_sum_model,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)
broom::tidy(mod)
broom::glance(mod)

# get temperature thresholds for probabilities
probabilities <- c(0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.25, 0.5)
thresholds <- tibble(
  probability = probabilities,
  temperature = (log(probabilities / (1 - probabilities)) - coef(mod)[1]) / coef(mod)[2]
) |>
  mutate(
    temperature = round(temperature, 2)
  )
thresholds |>
  kbl(
    col.names = c("Observation Probability", "Predicted Lizard Body Temperature (°C)"),
    align = "c"
  ) |>
  kable_styling(
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "center",
    font_size = 12
  )
```

```{r plot-threshold-temperature}
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-width: 5
#| fig-height: 5
#| out.width: 66%

tret <- survey_sum |>
  left_join(otm_data_ATL, by = c("year", "doy", "date")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_temp, y = presence)) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(0, ctmin_atl),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = c("darkblue", "steelblue"),
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    color = "gray", size = 4, alpha = 0.75,
    width = 0, height = 0.02
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "glm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    method.args = list(family = binomial(link = "logit")),
    color = "black", fill = "gray80",
    se = TRUE, linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.25),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Predicted Lizard Body Temperature in Canopy (°C)",
    y = "Observation Probability"
  )
tret
```

## The leaf litter buffers environmental temperatures

```{r plot-leaf-litter-buffering}
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-width: 5
#| fig-height: 5
#| out.width: 66%

# summarise data
otms_data_sum <- otms_data |>
  mutate(
    year = year + 2000,
    date = as.Date(paste(year, doy), format = "%Y %j"),
    month = format(date, "%b")
  ) |>
  group_by(location, lat, id, year, month, doy, microhabitat) |>
  summarise(
    min_temp = min(temp, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  filter(month %in% c("Dec", "Jan", "Feb")) |>
  group_by(location, lat, id, microhabitat, year) |>
  summarise(
    min_temp = mean(min_temp, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  ungroup()

# plot
buffering_plot <- otms_data_sum |>
  ggplot(aes(x = lat, y = min_temp)) +
  geom_line(
    data = pred_ctmin,
    aes(x = lat, y = ctmin, color = "CTmin"),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    aes(color = microhabitat, fill = microhabitat),
    method = "lm",
    alpha = 0.2,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = microhabitat),
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.5,
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.25, dodge.width = 1)
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = c(0),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "darkblue"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("branch" = "forestgreen", "leaflitter" = "darkorange", "CTmin" = "steelblue"),
    name = "Microhabitat",
    breaks = c("branch", "leaflitter", "CTmin"),
    labels = c("Canopy", "Leaf litter", expression(CT[min]))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("branch" = "forestgreen", "leaflitter" = "darkorange"),
    name = "Microhabitat",
    labels = c("Canopy", "Leaf litter"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(25, 35, by = 2.5),
    limits = c(25, 35),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = c(1, 1),
    legend.justification = c("right", "top"),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.key.spacing.y = unit(0.5, "lines"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "gray80", linewidth = 0.5)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Latitude (°N)",
    y = "Predicted Lizard Body Temperature (°C)"
  )
buffering_plot

```

```{r stats-leaf-litter-buffering}
# model
mod <- lm(min_temp ~ lat * microhabitat, data = otms_data_sum)
broom::tidy(mod)
broom::glance(mod)
```

```{r table-leaf-litter-buffering}
otms_data_sum |>
  group_by(location, lat, microhabitat) |>
  summarise(
    mean_min_temp = mean(min_temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_min_temp = sd(min_temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  ) |>
  mutate(
    est = paste(
      round(mean_min_temp, 1), "±",
      round(sd_min_temp, 1), "°C (n =", n, ")"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    microhabitat = ifelse(microhabitat == "branch", "Canopy", "Leaf litter")
  ) |>
  select(location, lat, microhabitat, est) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = microhabitat,
    values_from = est
  ) |>
  kbl(
    col.names = c("Location", "Latitude (°N)", "Canopy", "Leaf litter"),
    align = "c",
  ) |>
  kable_styling(
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "center",
    font_size = 12
  )
```
